parameters.name: ContentType
parameters.description:
The content type of the published message when using the MQTT 5.0 communication protocol.

This is typically used to store MIME types. For example, for a text file type: **text**, **plain**.

parameters.name: CorrelationData
parameters.description:
The correlation data in the request/response mode when using the MQTT 5.0 communication protocol. You can customize this value.

The message receiver can process the request based on the correlation data.

> Convert the correlation data to binary data and perform Base64 encoding to generate a String value.

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The name of the MQTT cloud gateway device.

><notice>
Specify this parameter only when you need to publish a message to a specified MQTT cloud gateway device.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this **ID** value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no **Overview** page or **ID** value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: MessageContent
parameters.description: The message body to send. Convert the original message to binary data and perform Base64 encoding to generate the message body.

parameters.name: PayloadFormatIndicator
parameters.description:
The payload format indicator of the published message when using the MQTT 5.0 communication protocol. Valid values:
- **0**: The message is undetermined byte data.
- **1**: The payload of the message is UTF-8 encoded character data.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device that receives the message belongs.

parameters.name: Qos
parameters.description:
The method for sending the message. Valid values:

- **0**: The message is sent at most once.
- **1**: The message is sent at least once. If a PUBACK message is not received for a QoS=1 message, the message is pushed to the device again when the device reconnects.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value **0** is used.

For more information about communication messages, see [Limits on connections and communications](~~30527~~).

parameters.name: ResponseTopic
parameters.description: The response topic in the request/response mode when using the MQTT 5.0 communication protocol, which is the communication topic. For more information, see [MQTT 5.0 protocol description](~~30540~~).

parameters.name: TopicFullName
parameters.description:
The custom topic of the device that receives the message.

- For <props="china"><ph>open-source MQTT managed devices and </ph></props>MQTT cloud gateway devices, the custom topic is the original custom topic of the device. For more information, see [Topic description](~~433806~~).
- For <props="china"><ph>non-open-source MQTT managed devices and </ph></props>non-MQTT cloud gateway devices, the custom topic supports the following formats:

    - `/${productKey}/${deviceName}/user/${TopicShortName}`: Sends a message to a specified device under the specified **ProductKey**.
    - `/broadcast/${productKey}/${CustomField}`: Sends a message to online devices that have subscribed to this topic under the specified **ProductKey**. `${productKey}` is the **ProductKey** of the product that receives the broadcast message. `${CustomField}` is a custom field that you define.

><notice> 
- The operation permission of the topic must be **Subscribe** or **Publish and Subscribe**.
- Before calling this operation, the device must have subscribed to the topic and not unsubscribed. Otherwise, the device cannot receive the published message.

></notice>

Methods to query custom topics:

- Call the [QueryProductTopic](~~69647~~) operation to query custom topics of a product.
- In the IoT Platform console, go to the **Product Details** page and click the **Topic Categories** tab to query custom topics of a product.
- In the IoT Platform console, go to the **Device Details** page and click the **Topic List** tab to view custom topics that the device has subscribed to.

parameters.name: UserProp
parameters.description: The list of user-defined properties when using the MQTT 5.0 communication protocol.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The key of the user-defined property when using the MQTT 5.0 communication protocol.

This parameter must be used together with **UserProp.N.Value**.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The value of the user-defined property when using the MQTT 5.0 communication protocol.

This parameter must be used together with **UserProp.N.Key**.
